introduction: Omni Family Health provides medical, dental and behavioral health services through Central Valley health centers. Ask about its sliding fee discount if paying for care is difficult.

who: Omni says it sees patients regardless of ability to pay. Its sliding discount uses family size and income and is available at or below 200% of federal poverty guidelines for covered services.
sections.get: The network offers primary and preventive care and other clinic services. The sliding fee program discounts eligible services; it does not make every outside service or expense free.
sections.docs: For discount screening, complete the Sliding Fee Discount Application and bring accepted income evidence such as a W-2, tax return, recent pay stubs or benefit records. Ask how to document no income or unusual circumstances.
sections.apply: Call or text 866-707-6664 to schedule. Obtain the discount form from Omni’s sliding fee page and bring it to your visit.
sections.after: Confirm the appointment location, expected charge and whether the requested service is within the discount’s scope. Ask about referral costs and coverage assistance before booking outside care.

faqs: Do I need insurance to receive care?
Omni says insurance is not required.
Is the discount based only on income?
Family size and income determine the applicable discount.
Where do I submit the discount form?
Bring the completed form and income evidence to your next visit, following Omni’s instructions.
Omni lists free interpretation services at its health centers.
